purpose: QUALIFICATION-CUSTODY-01 r3 (QCU) Rust resurrection rows for the witnesses this lane adapted: the bridge ownership helper's identity and output refusals and the H1 scratch witness's real ignore rule. Run through the PLR custody runner with --manifest, one disposable worktree per row, intended RED then restored GREEN. PLR rows stay in the PLR manifest; this file admits only whole-token QCU ids.

mutations.law: QCU r3 ownership helper: the inspected unit's Id, InvocationID and MainPID read after the executable helper must equal the identity read before it, so a reused pid or a restarted unit is refused rather than attributed to the owned runtime. Disabling the identity comparison admits every drift shape the seam witness feeds
QCU r3 ownership helper: the helper's output is accepted only as exactly one complete absolute path. Dropping the embedded-newline refusal admits a two-path answer, which the output witness reds on

QCU H1 scratch witness: the owned scratch root carries the repository's real .gitignore, so the fresh __pycache__ is ignored by the real __pycache__/ rule. Copying other bytes in its place makes the directory an ordinary untracked entry, and the anti-vacuity assertion reds before any count is compared
mutations.expected_diagnostic: is not git-ignored, so this witness cannot reproduce H1
